fixture.redactions: Workspace, marker, session and tool IDs replaced; unrelated metadata and thinking removed. Numbered Read content shape retained.

ablation.method: Create temporary copies with one mechanism removed; run the same observable subprocess checks against each copy. Compare shell baseline, guarded launch with exit-only classification, and guarded launch with stream classification.
ablation.limits: Deterministic fault replay measures mechanical protection, not how often a language model follows instructions. No repeated model trials or claimed prompt-compliance rates.

design_decisions.keep: One launch/inspect script, one conditional Boundary/Recovery reference, mechanical fault replays, contract lint.
design_decisions.reject: Post-hoc classification alone cannot prevent bad launches. Three references add navigation without a demonstrated benefit at this size. Permission presets, automatic fallback and task-specific acceptance remain outside the launcher.
design_decisions.fault_replays: All seven mechanism removals restored a regression. Exit-only classification falsely accepted missing-result and is_error controls; full classification rejected both and accepted the successful control.
design_decisions.context_budget: Words are reported as a context-size proxy, not a hard CI limit or an exact token count. Launcher-example protocol and link checks remain, without a fixed code-block count.
design_decisions.cancellation: The 2026-10-17 controls extend handlers from before Popen through receipt publication. Signals only set pending state; synchronous supervision handles cancellation. Once exit has been observed, late signals cannot erase the result. A cancelled child returning 0 still records stopped and FAILED. Same-group workers are covered on POSIX, detached processes are not. Denied termination names the owned PID and leaves evidence UNFINALIZED; the shutdown grace is not proof that an OS-unreapable process exited.
design_decisions.lifecycle_review: Sol independently reproduced startup/finalization races and rechecked the pending-signal repair. DeepSeek completed a read-only review through the selected wrapper; its stop-permission error finding has an injected-EPERM regression. Cancellation cause and actual child exit intentionally remain separate. An earlier external review timed out and is retained as failed, not independent completion evidence.
design_decisions.review: Independent Sol and Grok design judgments were cross-checked against source and raw probes. Sol's orphan/conflicting tool-result findings were reproduced and fixed. Grok's design text was available but its process exceeded the deadline; the separate implementation review also timed out, so neither is recorded as a passed execution check.
